verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of recurring execution is a passing listing of supported refreshable materialized views, which periodically recompute a SQL query inside the database. That is a narrow, SQL-only form of recurring work, and the pack never documents its scheduling semantics. Interval-based alert rules (adjacent alerting feature), pausable batch jobs (not scheduled), and automated backups (not user-defined) do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: a general job/workflow scheduler (cron-style schedules for arbitrary jobs or multi-step workflows), documentation of schedule configuration, agent/API-driven schedule management, run history for scheduled jobs, and independent corroboration.
